WITH telescope_averages AS (
    SELECT
        t.telescregistry,
        t.equipstatus,
        AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
    FROM telescopes AS t
    JOIN signals AS s
      ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus
), status_averages AS (
    SELECT equipstatus, AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate
    FROM telescope_averages
    GROUP BY equipstatus
), first_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM status_averages
), first_kept AS (
    SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate,
           sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_rate AS excess_first
    FROM status_averages AS sa
    CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm
    WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_rate
), second_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM first_kept
), remaining AS (
    SELECT fk.avg_pulse_rate,
           fk.excess_first,
           fk.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_rate AS excess_second
    FROM first_kept AS fk
    CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm
    WHERE fk.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_remaining_status_rate,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean
FROM remaining;

assumptions.assumption: Statuses with no matched telescope-signal pulse-rate values are excluded from the status averages; AVG ignores missing pulse rates, and the inner join drops signals without a matching telescope.
